name: Bank Creation and Lifecycle
description: Create, open, close, archive, and delete memory banks with transactional guarantees. Each bank transitions through a defined lifecycle state machine.
purpose: Ensure memory banks have a well-defined lifecycle with transactional integrity — preventing partial creation, orphaned banks, or data loss during transition operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Bank lifecycle states: pending, active, closed, archived, deleted
Create operation is atomic — bank exists or it does not
Open transitions from pending to active
Close transitions from active to closed; prevents writes
Archive transitions from closed to archived; data preserved but offline
Delete removes all bank data with cascading cleanup
Lifecycle transitions are recorded in a journal
Concurrent lifecycle operations are serialized per bank
rollback_strategy: Revert bank to previous lifecycle state; clean up partial artifacts
recovery_strategy: Replay lifecycle journal to rebuild current state
